summary: A personal in-office attendance compliance application with interactive calendar tracking, configurable day-per-period targets, and future planning. It includes a web frontend and a persistent API-backed data store.

workspaceSignals.decisionReason: The workspace contains no application source, manifests, or Azure Functions configuration.

questions.question: Which programming language for Attendance Compliance API?
questions.rationale: TypeScript provides a shared type model with the planned frontend.

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Node.js and TypeScript on Azure Functions

questions.question: Describe the features or API routes for Attendance Compliance API.
questions.answer: Create and update attendance policies with X required office days over a Y-week period; record office days; retrieve calendar and compliance summaries; create future attendance plans; compare planned and actual compliance over time.
questions.rationale: Distilled from the user's requested attendance entry, calendar tracking, compliance monitoring, and planning mode.
questions.recommendedChoice: Create and update attendance policies with X required office days over a Y-week period; record office days; retrieve calendar and compliance summaries; create future attendance plans; compare planned and actual compliance over time.

questions.question: Which programming language for Attendance Compliance Web App?
questions.rationale: TypeScript supports reliable calendar and API data models.

questions.question: Which frontend framework for Attendance Compliance Web App?
questions.rationale: React provides a mature component ecosystem for interactive calendar and planning views.

questions.question: Describe the features or API routes for Attendance Compliance Web App.
questions.answer: Interactive monthly calendar to mark in-office days; policy setup for X days across Y weeks; current and historical compliance progress; future planning mode; planned versus actual tracking; responsive dashboard.
questions.rationale: Distilled from the user's requested interactive calendar, compliance tracking, and future planning mode.
questions.recommendedChoice: Interactive monthly calendar to mark in-office days; policy setup for X days across Y weeks; current and historical compliance progress; future planning mode; planned versus actual tracking; responsive dashboard.

questions.question: Which data stores does your app need?
questions.rationale: PostgreSQL is suited to policies, attendance entries, and period calculations; Blob Storage is required by the recommended Azure Functions backend.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: The app does not persist data or use storage, queues, or caches

questions.question: Does your app need authentication?
questions.rationale: Attendance records are personal and workforce-oriented, so organizational sign-in is the likely fit.

options.label: Mock auth middleware
options.description: Testable local identity without an external provider

options.label: Microsoft Entra External ID
options.description: Customer identity with sign-up and social logins
